claims: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
Artemis II is designed to validate SLS rocket in deep space.
Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
A key objective of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
A key objective of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
A key objective of Artemis II is testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
The Artemis II journey passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond the Moon.
The four Artemis II astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
The four Artemis II astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
The four Artemis II astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis III.
Artemis II serves as a test to prepare for Artemis IV.
Artemis III will land humans on the lunar surface.
Artemis IV will land humans on the lunar surface.
The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
